turns.text: How do you feel about the voice quality compared to competitors you've tried?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We benchmarked against two other providers and 12Labs won on naturalness, no contest. The breathing and pacing sound human. Competitors sound noticeably more robotic on longer passages.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Language support — we need Swedish and Finnish for Nordic clients, and both are still labeled 'beta' with noticeably lower quality than English.
